A David Lynch palette generator

Source: R/colors.R
lynch_palette.Rd

![](sticker.png "Lynch sticker") Color palettes from David Lynch films.

lynch_palette(name, n, type = c("discrete", "sequential", "diverging"))

Arguments

name

Name of the palette, such as `"twin_peaks"` or `"twin_peaks_safe"`. See `names(lynch_palettes)`, `names(lynch_sequential)` and `names(lynch_diverging)`.

n

Number of colours. If omitted, uses all colours. Discrete palettes offer at most their own colours; sequential and diverging ramps are interpolated to any `n`. Most discrete colour schemes are derived from this Pin on Pinterest.

type

`"discrete"` for categories, `"sequential"` for ordered values, `"diverging"` for values either side of a midpoint.

Value

A vector of colours.

Examples

lynch_palette("twin_peaks")

lynch_palette("blue_velvet", 3)

lynch_palette("twin_peaks_safe")

lynch_palette("dune", 12, type = "sequential")

lynch_palette("mulholland_drive", type = "diverging")
